name: NovelAI Image SDK v0.1.8
body:
Fixes the version stamping that made the previous release publish under the wrong number.

## Fixed

- `cargo xtask sync-versions` reported every manifest as up to date while leaving it on the old version: it matched a literal `{version}` template with `str::replace`, which can never match. PyPI therefore received a `0.1.0` wheel during the v0.1.7 release. The pattern is now compiled with the version slot as a capture group, every match is rewritten, and the npm platform dependencies are covered too.

## Published by this release

| Registry | Version |
|---|---|
| crates.io | 0.1.8 |
| PyPI | 0.1.8 |
| Maven Central | 0.1.8 |
| GitHub release (Swift XCFramework) | 0.1.8 |

npm remains blocked on the token: publishing requires a one-time password, so an automation token that bypasses 2FA is needed.
